<script type="text/javascript" src="//cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/slick-carousel@1.8.1/slick/slick.min.js"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function() {
        var $slider = $('.results_list');
        var slickInitialized = false;

        function manageSlider() {
            var windowWidth = $(window).width();

            if (windowWidth < 1200) {
                if (!slickInitialized) {
                    // 1. Mark original items so we know what to keep
                    $slider.children('.result_list_item').addClass('original-item');

                    // 2. Clone only the original items and append them
                    $slider.children('.original-item').clone().removeClass('original-item').addClass('cloned-item').appendTo($slider);

                    // 3. Initialize Slick
                    $slider.slick({
                        slidesToShow: 4, 
                       autoplay: true,
                      autoplaySpeed: 6000,
                        slidesToScroll: 1,
                        infinite: true,
                        dots: false,          
                        arrows: true,
                        responsive: [
                            { breakpoint: 992, settings: { slidesToShow: 3 } },
                            { breakpoint: 768, settings: { slidesToShow: 2 } },
                            { breakpoint: 600, settings: { slidesToShow: 1 } }
                        ]
                    });
                    slickInitialized = true;
                }
            } else {
                if (slickInitialized) {
                    // 1. Completely destroy Slick slider
                    $slider.slick('unslick');

                    // 2. Wipe out the mobile cloned items from the DOM
                    $slider.children('.cloned-item').remove();
                    $slider.children('.original-item').removeClass('original-item');

                    slickInitialized = false;
                }
            }
        }

        manageSlider();

        var resizeTimer;
        $(window).on('resize', function() {
            clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
            resizeTimer = setTimeout(manageSlider, 100);
        });
    });
</script>
 <script>
let lineMoveAdded = false;
let timer = null;

setInterval(function () {

    const $section = $('.platform-ecomm-op-main-two');

    // Active-1
    if ($section.hasClass('active-1') && !lineMoveAdded) {

        lineMoveAdded = true;

        timer = setTimeout(function () {
            $section.addClass('line-move');
        }, 1000);
    }

    // Active-2
    if ($section.hasClass('active-2')) {

        $section.removeClass('line-move');

        clearTimeout(timer);

        // Allow next cycle
        lineMoveAdded = false;
    }

    // Active-3
    if ($section.hasClass('active-3')) {

        $section.removeClass('line-move');

        clearTimeout(timer);

        // Allow next cycle
        lineMoveAdded = false;
    }

}, 100);
 </script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function () {

    $('.feature-btn:first').addClass('active');

    $('.feature-image').hide();
    $('.feature-image:first').show();

    $('.feature-btn').on('click', function () {

        let index = $(this).index();

        $('.feature-btn').removeClass('active');
        $(this).addClass('active');

        $('.feature-image:visible').fadeOut(200, function () {
            $('.feature-image').eq(index).fadeIn(300);
        });

    });
  

});
 
</script>

<script>
jQuery(document).ready(function ($) {
    const $html = $('html');
    const userAgent = navigator.userAgent;
    const vendor = navigator.vendor || '';

    const isIOS =
        /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(userAgent) ||
        (
            navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' &&
            navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1
        );

    const isChromeIOS = /CriOS/i.test(userAgent);
    const isFirefoxIOS = /FxiOS/i.test(userAgent);
    const isEdgeIOS = /EdgiOS/i.test(userAgent);

    const isSafari =
        /Safari/i.test(userAgent) &&
        /Apple Computer/i.test(vendor) &&
        !/Chrome|Chromium|CriOS|Edg|EdgiOS|OPR|FxiOS/i.test(userAgent);

    const isMac =
        /Macintosh|Mac OS X/i.test(userAgent) &&
        !isIOS;

    console.log('Browser detection started');
    console.log('User Agent:', userAgent);
    console.log('Vendor:', vendor);
    console.log('Is Mac:', isMac);
    console.log('Is iOS:', isIOS);
    console.log('Is Safari:', isSafari);
    console.log('Is iOS Chrome:', isChromeIOS);

    if (isMac && isSafari) {
        $html.addClass('is-mac-safari');
        console.log('Class added: is-mac-safari');
    }

    if (isIOS) {
        $html.addClass('is-ios');
        console.log('Class added: is-ios');
    }

    if (isIOS && isSafari) {
        $html.addClass('is-ios-safari');
        console.log('Class added: is-ios-safari');
    }

    if (isIOS && isChromeIOS) {
        $html.addClass('is-ios-chrome');
        console.log('Class added: is-ios-chrome');
    }

    if (isIOS && isFirefoxIOS) {
        $html.addClass('is-ios-firefox');
        console.log('Class added: is-ios-firefox');
    }

    if (isIOS && isEdgeIOS) {
        $html.addClass('is-ios-edge');
        console.log('Class added: is-ios-edge');
    }

    console.log('Final HTML classes:', $html.attr('class'));
});
</script>

No more reconciling exports by hand. Every channel and warehouse stays in sync, so every forecast and recommendation runs on current numbers.
